text: Implemented opt-in temporal pose regularization in the shared motion estimator. Added deterministic one-pass trace smoothing, reference preservation, recomputed final diagnostics for returned poses, control adapter coverage, estimator regression tests, and docs updates. Verified with sbt -J-Xmx3G motionJVM/test motionJS/test. Repo-wide sbt -J-Xmx3G testAll is currently blocked by unrelated fitJVM dirty-tree failures in GlsSuite and FitPlanExecutorSuite.
